notes: The weir is a curved, stepped stone wall about 3.8 m high, with a crest and five steps on the downstream (front, +z) face. In plan it bows toward the front, with a left abutment of boulders. At the +x end is a sluice house about 7.25 x 6.8 x 6.55 m with a corbelled cornice, a door, a carved-hand panel and a low outlet. A sloping stone channel runs from the outlet toward +z. Scale: about 40 px/m on the Front view; the other views are drawn smaller and do not fully agree. The Left view leaves out the outlet channel that the Top view shows (about 9 m long), so I made the channel 8 m as a compromise.
